mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar, CASE WHEN u.phone IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(u.phone) >= 11 THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(u.phone, 1, 3), '****', SUBSTRING(u.phone, 8)) ELSE '' END AS phone, fr.remark, fr.is_blocked AS isBlocked, fr.created_at AS createdAt FROM friend_relation fr INNER JOIN user u ON fr.friend_id = u.user_id WHERE fr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend_relation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_blocked = 0
